title: Manzwi Ari Parutivi Pemvura Yakanyarara
intro: Fungidzira nharaunda isina zita reguta kana mutongi, asi remvura yakadzikama yakapoteredza hupenyu. Ndima shoma chete ndidzo dzinorangarira nharaunda iyi, inogara ichinyorwa pakati peavo vakaramba kutungamirirwa. Teerera sezvavanotaura kubva muchivande.
clues: Tiri nzanga inonyorwa muKorani, asi nyaya yedu yakazara ichiri yakavanzika.
Tinogara tichitaurwa pamwe chete nevaya vakaramba, sevanhu veAd neThamud.
Tinonzi Shamwari dzeAr-Rass, tsime iro hupenyu hwedu hwakabatana naro.
Takaramba mutumwa akatumwa kwatiri negwara rakajeka.
Isu tiri pakati peavo vakaramba vatumwa vese vakatumwa naAllah.
Takatarisana nekutyisidzirwa kwakazadziswa kune wese anoramba pamberi pedu, kuparadzwa nekuda kwekurambwa kwedu.

arabic: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ ۚ كُلٌّۭ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
verse: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled. (50:14)
